acceptance.assertion: Before preparation and immediately before apply, authenticate current GitHub protected main as this authority's one-file merge descendant, prove required validate (3.10), validate (3.12) and registry-registration-preflight/freshness checks green for exactly that revision, and bind current source diff digest.

Before prepare-intent and immediately before apply, in addition to exact protected-main CI, deployed-source/Registry/manifest ancestry and reserved-executor predicates, collect two FRESH independent user-systemd HOST-namespaced manual observations; the first is appended to approval-intent before prepare, the second to source-precondition before apply. Verify Linger=yes via loginctl show-user alex -p Linger, and verify with findmnt/statvfs that the configured persistent user_unit_dir (/home/alex/.config/systemd/user), its timers.target.wants, and trusted drop-in directories are actual non-tmpfs durable RW Btrfs paths outside /run. After prepare, require intent.user_unit_dir to equal /home/alex/.config/systemd/user byte-for-path; otherwise refuse apply. The source and installed runtime must agree on the ENTIRE set of managed scheduler units: exactly both .service and .timer for bureau-halfhour-operator, bureau-curator, bureau-operator-control, bureau-verifier-control, bureau-closure-planner, and bureau-task-supply. If target adds or removes a managed name, FAIL CLOSED before any effect; this authority does not approve set migration. Snapshot for every managed path its present/absent state, SHA-256, mode, FragmentPath, UnitFileState, ActiveState/SubState and service Result/ExecMainStatus. Snapshot the persistent timers.target.wants enablement paths and link targets, including proof they are not masks or runtime-only overlays. Require bureau-task-supply.timer already enabled/active/waiting and bureau-task-supply.service Result=success and ExecMainStatus=0 BEFORE any effect; snapshot the other five timer intents and require their enabled/active state to be preserved (do not enable optional timers). For ALL twelve units, query DropInPaths before both checkpoints, including empty sets. Require exact pre-approved persistent drop-in paths and content SHA-256 and reject any runtime-only (/run/user), unexpected, masked or mutable drop-in. On this host the expected nonempty set is exactly bureau-verifier-control.service.d/20-grabowski-sqlite-wal.conf at /home/alex/.config/systemd/user/bureau-verifier-control.service.d/20-grabowski-sqlite-wal.conf with SHA-256 e4caecbcc882c9fb62b5bb696d4dee784cae6fa923b0569f3b5908b1274f9934; every other managed unit must have EMPTY DropInPaths. Persist the complete pre-effect inventory as manual-observation content in the EXISTING approval-intent and source-precondition evidence classes, explicitly validate immediately before each action, and stop before a single-use effect if any predicate is unproven. No unsupported evidence class, invented automatic validator or reboot test is claimed.

Use the installed Grabowski systemd-user reserved bureau-runtime-refresh-apply executor with the exact immutable StateStore authority revision, caller ownership and currently held leases. Admit at most one effect; after uncertain outcomes reconcile against attempt/result/manifest/StateStore without blind retry.

After the reserved one-shot effect and BEFORE any single-use finalization or lease release, independently verify one protected main commit across immutable installed release, package tree, canonical Registry, manifest, launcher, and ALL twelve user-systemd fragments under exactly the intent-bound PERSISTENT /home/alex/.config/systemd/user, with per-file content SHA and mode. The entire managed set must still be exactly the six names established before effect, with no added/removed units, file masks, tmpfs fragments or /run/user-only substitutes. Readback includes durable Btrfs findmnt/statvfs, persistent timers.target.wants symlink targets and Linger=yes. For each managed unit, DropInPaths POST set MUST equal EXACTLY the unit's recorded PRE set, including each absolute path and SHA256. Empty POST is permitted only when that unit's PRE set was empty. Specifically bureau-verifier-control.service MUST retain /home/alex/.config/systemd/user/bureau-verifier-control.service.d/20-grabowski-sqlite-wal.conf with SHA256 e4caecbcc882c9fb62b5bb696d4dee784cae6fa923b0569f3b5908b1274f9934; any lost or new drop-in fails readback. Every timer must retain its recorded PRE UnitFileState and ActiveState/SubState; bureau-task-supply.timer must still be enabled/active/waiting and its persistent wants link valid. For every managed service, require Result=success and ExecMainStatus=0, explicitly including bureau-task-supply.service. Bureau doctor and task-supply must prove healthy runtime plus NORMAL claimable task routing, not fallback scouts alone; if persistent unit and store convergence is correct but other independent queue-policy blockers remain, record those separately rather than fabricate normal-claimability success. Existing allowed immutable-readback and state-store-integrity evidence must include both manual host observations, post-effect snapshot, release/Registry diff, and incident/rollback result if any. A successful effect result is NOT proof of independent readback, normal claimability, reboot survival or successful closeout.

After successful immutable readback, finalize the single-use authority and release its exact Grabowski resource leases. Resume normal Bureau task routing and source publication through their separate reviewed contracts. This authority grants no NixOS/Pop!_OS disk mutation, repo writer of another lane, general queue or claim mutation, GitHub merge or product deployment.

rollback.strategy: Maintain an intact integrity-verified pre-effect Bureau source release 4dbd918736489a9faa892bafc8c7bb77c3f0c5c7, manifest, Registry snapshot, launchers and entire INTENT-BOUND per-path scheduler preimage before any apply. The complete snapshot includes twelve managed service/timer fragment files and every persistent wants-link and active-state intent, each exact present/absent state, per-path SHA/mode, and ALL approved persistent DropInPaths including the verifier WAL override hash; it also records absence for any candidate-introduced path and the pre-effect Linger+mount facts. Never hard-code a count of six files. CASE A: For in-process apply failure, the installed converge_user_scheduler exception path and rollback_effect can restore its native tracked scheduler fragments, enablement links and release pointers. Those helpers do NOT by themselves establish restoration of arbitrary service drop-ins or every service runtime property. Reobserve every recorded preimage item; any uncovered mutation/drop-in/drift requires separately authorized incident recovery and blocks authority finalization. CASE B: For process crash, host reboot or started.json with no authoritative validated result, resume_policy=never. Do not repeat the one-shot executor, auto-consume authority, infer success from absent output, or discard rollback artifacts. Reconcile actual manifest, Registry, launchers, fragment and DropInPath inventories first, then restore exact previous preimage through a SEPARATELY authorized recovery route if any mismatch is observed. The exhausted TaskSpec never grants itself incident-recovery powers. CASE C: If apply reports deployed/already_current but the subsequent independent source, persistency, DropInPaths, service health, Linger, doctor or NORMAL routing readback fails, treat the FULLY or partly switched release alike as an UNPROVEN failed outcome: do NOT finalize the authority or release leases as success. Retain the exact successful result and started/intent receipts; invoke separately authorized out-of-band incident recovery to re-activate the retained previous release/manifest/Registry/launchers and all original unit+drop-in files and links, delete only exact target-introduced paths whose preimage provably recorded absence within the approved scope, then reobserve. ALL cases share the SAME required ROLLBACK READBACK before recovery closure: old source 4dbd918736489a9faa892bafc8c7bb77c3f0c5c7 package and Registry/manifest/launcher SHA, ALL per-path fragment modes/hashes, exact pre-effect DropInPaths sets and SHA, persistent wants-link targets, every timer UnitFileState and ActiveState/SubState, service Result=success/ExecMainStatus=0, Linger=yes, durable Btrfs mount and Bureau doctor. If recovery is unavailable or any check fails, preserve blocked incident, old artifacts, logs and leases under applicable policy without asserting success. This authority NEVER changes NixOS, Pop!_OS, other repositories, any foreign task/lease, or bypasses Captain.
